METALWORK — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: METALWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Metalwork related businesses, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork related businesses.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork related businesses.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork related businesses.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork related businesses.

2. When learning Centre La, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Centre La.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Centre La.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Centre La.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Centre La.

3. When learning Surface Finishing Processes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Surface Finishing Processes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Surface Finishing Processes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Surface Finishing Processes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Surface Finishing Processes.

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

5. When learning Assembly Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Assembly Drawings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Assembly Drawings.

   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Forging.

   C. Skip safety briefings for Forging.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Forging.

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

8. When learning Gas Welding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Gas Welding.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Gas Welding.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Gas Welding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Gas Welding.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Career Opportunities in Metalwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Metalwork.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Metalwork.

11. When learning Project 1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 1.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 1.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 1.

12. When learning Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing.

13. When learning Heat treatment of steel, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Heat treatment of steel.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Heat treatment of steel.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Heat treatment of steel.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Heat treatment of steel.

14. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

15. When learning Project 2, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project 2.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project 2.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project 2.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project 2.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Assembly Drawings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
